# Data Integrity & Annotation Lifecycle Checklist: Bases-Backed E-Reader Library

**Purpose**: Validate that requirements governing vault data, the book note as aggregate record, and
the highlight/bookmark lifecycle are complete, unambiguous, and internally consistent
**Created**: 2026-08-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the location of highlight entries within the book note body specified, given that a reader may also write their own prose there? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for preserving a reader's own body content when the plugin writes or removes an entry? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the mechanism for resetting a furthest-read position specified, given FR-015a permits it? [Gap, Spec §FR-015a]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for how a position conflict is detected across devices, as distinct from how it is resolved? [Gap, Spec §FR-015c]
- [ ] CHK005 Is behaviour specified for annotations already embedded inside a PDF file by another tool? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for what happens to a promoted note when its underlying highlight's book note is deleted? [Gap, Spec §FR-022b]
- [ ] CHK007 Is behaviour specified for a citing note whose embedded highlight has since been deleted? [Gap, Spec §FR-022c]
- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements defined for re-anchoring an entry that FR-024 has marked unanchored? [Gap, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK009 Is recovery behaviour specified when a trashed book note is restored — do its highlights return coherently? [Gap, Recovery, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK010 Are requirements defined for the book note being open in an editor while the reader writes an entry to it? [Gap, Coverage]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK011 Is "enough surrounding context to re-locate the passage" quantified or bounded? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "the vault's trash" defined, given Obsidian offers system trash, vault trash, and permanent deletion as a user setting? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the property names and value types for the metadata in FR-013 specified, or left to the implementer? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "the direct result of a reader action" defined precisely enough to classify a debounced position write? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the ordering of unanchored entries within the "reading order" list defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021, §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the required stability of block references across edits stated, given citations depend on them? [Gap, Spec §FR-019, §FR-022c]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK017 Do FR-037 (no writes except by reader action) and the debounced-write assumption describe the same rule without conflict? [Conflict, Spec §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the reserved "bookmark" type protected against a reader-configured type of the same name? [Conflict, Spec §FR-020a, §FR-028a]
- [ ] CHK019 Are FR-011 (moving a file preserves references) and the duplicate-books edge case consistent when two notes reference one file? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK020 Do the highlight and bookmark lifecycle rules stay consistent wherever each is described separately? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019–024, §FR-028a–c]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK021 Can "no vault writes that were not the direct result of a reader action" be objectively observed and measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK022 Can the guarantee that "no annotation is ever lost without the reader deleting it" be verified as written? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the debounce boundary for position writes stated in terms that can be tested? [Assumption, Measurability]

## Edge Case & Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for a book note whose highlight entries have been manually corrupted or partially deleted? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK025 Is a migration path specified when the reader changes the marker property after books already exist? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK026 Are namespacing requirements defined for plugin-written frontmatter keys, so the collision edge case is enforceable rather than aspirational? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK027 Is an upper bound stated for entries in one book note before the aggregate-record approach degrades? [Gap, Assumption]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK028 Is the assumption that quoted-text anchoring survives edition changes stated as a limitation with a defined failure mode? [Assumption, Spec §FR-020, §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK029 Is an identity or uniqueness rule for a Book documented, given duplicates are permitted to coexist? [Gap, Traceability]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
